risks.description: GPL-3.0 license. Integrating GPL code or linking to it may require VISERON to also be GPL-licensed. Using ComfyUI as a separate HTTP service (API boundary) is likely the safest approach, but legal review is mandatory before any integration.
risks.mitigation: Legal review. If approved, integrate via REST API only — never embed or distribute ComfyUI code.

risks.description: VISERON runs on CPU (Ollama uses CPU). Wan2.1 and ComfyUI require dedicated GPU. Without GPU, all multimodal capabilities are theoretical.
risks.mitigation: Deploy GPU server (RTX 4090+) accessible via local network. Run Python inference services on GPU server, call from VISERON via subprocess/HTTP.

risks.description: Subprocess execution of Python scripts. If prompt input is not sanitized, could allow command injection.
risks.mitigation: Sanitize all user prompts before passing to subprocess. Use JSON input format (not shell strings). Validate output files exist before serving.

risks.description: Python subprocess can fail, hang, or consume excessive resources. Adds failure point to otherwise-deterministic TypeScript execution.
risks.mitigation: Timeout wrapper (10 min default). Retry with backoff (max 3). Process kill on timeout. Resource monitoring.

risks.description: Three of five requested technologies returned 404 at expected URLs. Cannot audit or integrate unknown repositories.
risks.mitigation: Request correct URLs from source. Evaluate alternative tools for same capabilities.

realityGate: PASS — all classifications based on real repository analysis. No simulated capabilities. 2/5 verified, 3/5 require URL correction.
